detail: MANUAL LAUNCH IN PROGRESS. The owner is publishing the first four videos by hand (2026-08-31). The loop must not publish while she does: YouTube cannot replace a video file, so an autonomous publish landing mid-session creates a video that can only be deleted and re-uploaded, losing its URL and any watch time. Reset only when she says the manual session is finished. Deliberate hold, not a fault.
